{{Quote|What&hellip; What could you hate enough&hellip; to destroy me?''"<br />"''Myself.|Darth Maul and Darth Vader|<ref name="Resurrection" />}}
In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a '''duel''' was fought on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Kalakar Six]] between the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]]. Maul was previously [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|defeated]] [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] prior to the [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who then took Anakin Skywalker, the boy who would become Vader, as his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]. Skywalker was eventually lured to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] by Maul's [[Sith Master/Legends|master]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], who was also known publcly as [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine. By 0 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], three [[Dark side adept/Legends|dark side adherents]] believed that a remnant of the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] remained in Vader, and that he was a threat to the future of the dark side. They either resurrected, [[Cloning/Legends|cloned]], or conjured a vision of Maul for the purpose of fighting Vader and lured him to Kalakar Six through false intelligence concerning the [[Death Star plans/Legends|Death Star plans]], which had been recently [[Battle of Toprawa|stolen]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

Vader arrived on the [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] moon with a unit of eight [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and entered a [[Unidentified fortress|fortress]] to search for the plans. Maul and the adherents killed all of the stormtroopers, after which they revealed themselves to Vader, accused him of being an unfit apprentice to the Emperor, and challenged him to duel Maul. They began to fight with their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], with Vader using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to fire his dead [[Trooper/Legends|trooper's]] [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|rifles]] at Maul, and Maul attempting to knock Vader into the [[Magma/Legends|lava]] pit below them. Both combatants taunted each other throughout the duel, with Vader calling Maul an imposter and Maul claiming that Vader had too much of the light side in him to overcome Maul's hatred.

The duel proceeded to a rock platform floating in the lava, where Vader sliced through Maul's [[Darth Maul's double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]] and Maul damaged Vader's [[Darth Vader's armor|helmet]], knocking the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith]] to his [[Limb/Legends|knees]]. As Maul stood behind Vader and prepared to strike a killing blow, Vader directed his own [[Darth Vader's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] into his own body, which also stabbed Maul&mdash;fatally. In his last moments, Maul asked what Vader could hate enough to have defeated him, and Vader replied that it was himself. The adherents were shocked at their defeat and nearly struck down by Vader, but they were instead [[Force lightning/Legends|killed]] by Palpatine, who had arrived at the fortress. Vader departed the moon to continue seeking the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] plans, and he would ultimately return to the light and [[Battle of Endor/Legends|betray]] the Emperor, leading to both of their deaths.

==Prelude==
===Paths of the Sith===
{{Quote|The dark side can deliver what you most desire. Admit it.''"<br />"''I created you. I can make you go away.''"<br />"''But I will return.|An apparition of Darth Maul and Anakin Skywalker in 28 BBY|<ref name="Jedi Quest">[[Jedi Quest 1|''Jedi Quest'' 1]]</ref>}}
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], briefly encountered the [[Youngling/Legends|child]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. On a mission to abduct [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], Maul had been surveilling Skywalker and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], and he nearly ran over the child on his [[Bloodfin/Legends|speeder]] before engaging Jinn in a [[Duel on Tatooine/Legends|lightsaber duel]]. Skywalker and Jinn were able to escape off-planet, but Maul later had another [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|duel]] with Jinn and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] on Naboo.<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> 

[[File:Jedi_Quest_1_unlettered_cover.jpg|thumb|right|200px|As Anakin Skywalker, Vader had previously encountered a vision of Maul following the latter's apparent death on Naboo.]]
Maul [[Death/Legends|killed]] Jinn but was subsequently bisected by Kenobi and fell down a reactor shaft,<ref name="TPM" /> presumed to be dead, although he actually survived.<ref name="Brothers">{{TCW|Brothers (episode)}}</ref> Kenobi was then promoted to the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and took  Skywalker as his apprentice.<ref name="TPM" /> In [[28 BBY]], on the planet [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]], Kenobi sent Skywalker into a [[Crystal Cave/Legends|cave]] to construct his [[Anakin Skywalker's first lightsaber/Legends|first lightsaber]], where the Padawan had a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] of Maul, a manifestation of his fears. The apparition taunted Skywalker, referencing his hatred for Maul for killing Jinn, encouraging his anger, and suggesting a desire for the power of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. The vision of Maul then disappeared, while promising to return.<ref name="Jedi Quest" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], which [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|began]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> Maul was found alive by his brother, [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], on the planet [[Lotho Minor/Legends|Lotho Minor]], and returned to the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="Brothers" /> Maul was later [[Battle of Mandalore/Legends|captured]] by Sidious and then freed by his [[Shadow Collective/Legends|allies]],<ref name="Son of Dathomir 1">[[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 1|''Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir'' 1]]</ref> though Sidious believed Maul was weakened to the point of no longer threatening his [[Grand Plan/Legends|plans]].<ref name="Son of Dathomir 4">[[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 4|''Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir'' 4]]</ref>

At the conclusion of the Clone Wars in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> Sidious, desiring a new apprentice, seduced Skywalker to the dark side of the Force, christening him as [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader. Sidious, known publicly as [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine, also transformed the Galactic Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[Order 66/Legends|enacted]] the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], eliminating a majority of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Kenobi survived the initial purge and [[Duel on Mustafar/Legends|fought]] Vader on the [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] planet [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], where he left Vader dismembered and significantly burned. Amidala, who had become Vader's [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], died shortly afterwards, having been [[Telekinesis/Legends|choked]] by Vader and lost the will to live following his betrayal; her last words were that there was still goodness within her husband. Vader thereafter required [[Cyborg/Legends|cybernetic]] reconstruction and an [[Darth Vader's armor/Legends|armored suit]] to stay alive,<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> which caused Palpatine to regard Vader as a disappointment and desire to train a new apprentice.<ref name="NEC" /> Vader spent the following [[Standard year/Legends|years]] as Palpatine's right-hand [[Gender/Legends|man]].<ref name="NEGTC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>

===Kalakar Six===
{{Quote|Strange. I sense something&hellip; familiar. Captain, two of your men will accompany me to search the fortress. The rest of you split into teams and reconnoiter the surrounding area.|Darth Vader, shortly after landing on Kalakar Six|<ref name="Resurrection" />}}
[[File:Kalakar_Six.png|thumb|left|200px|The adherents who engineered the duel watch as Vader's shuttle arrives on Kalakar Six.]]
Eventually, a group of three [[dark side adherents]] based on the volcanic [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Kalakar Six]] believed that Vader was unsuited for the role of Sidious's apprentice due to a remnant of the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]], and so they used dark side abilities to either resurrect,<ref name="Resurrection" /> [[Cloning/Legends|clone]], or create a vision of<ref name="Chee">{{Blog|holocron|22/comments|Movie Characters killed in the EU}}</ref> Maul, believing that the Zabrak would defeat Vader and take his place.<ref name="Resurrection" /> In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Death Star plans/Legends|plans]] for the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], a planet-destroying [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], were [[Battle of Toprawa|stolen]] on the planet [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawa]] by operatives of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], who were engaged in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] with the Empire.<ref name="NEC" /> The [[Dark side adept/Legends|adherents]] leaked false information suggesting that the plans would be transferred to another courier on Kalakar Six, which was picked up by Imperial informants. At Palpatine's instruction, Vader led a group of eight [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] there aboard a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]]. Their arrival was observed by the adherents, who assured themselves that their plans would come to pass soon.<ref name="Resurrection" />

Once the Imperial troops had landed on the moon, Vader explained the purpose of his mission to a [[Unidentified stormtrooper captain (Kalakar Six)|stormtrooper captain]], elaborating that they either needed to recover the plans or determine if their intelligence was false. [[Force sense/Legends|Sensing]] a familiar presence, Vader then ordered two of the stormtroopers to accompany him to the nearby [[Unidentified fortress|fortress]] while the others split into two-person teams to sweep the surrounding area. The stormtrooper [[Captain/Legends|captain]] ordered the others to communicate via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] and rendezvous at their [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] after two [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]]. Two other stormtroopers began complaining about the creepy atmosphere of Kalakar Six and were reprimanded by the captain, who insisted that Vader would not fail the Emperor nor tolerate failure from his subordinates.<ref name="Resurrection" />

==The duel==
===Dead stormtroopers===
{{Quote|Lord Vader, please! It was just idle talk! He meant nothing by&mdash;puh-please&hellip; Lord Vader&hellip;''" [choking]<br />"''It's not my doing.|One of the stormtroopers and Darth Vader|<ref name="Resurrection" />}}
[[File:Maul_stormtroopers.png|thumb|right|200px|Maul eliminates Vader's stormtroopers.]]
While mid-sentence, the captain was decapitated by Maul's [[Darth Maul's double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]]. One of the stormtroopers spotted Maul and fired into the heavy [[Water/Legends|fog]]. Maul then leapt into the air onto rock mound, with the [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|blaster]]-fire striking down another stormtrooper. One of the stormtroopers saw Maul's perch and fired, but he deflected their blast onto another trooper and then leapt down to impale them. Maul then disappeared from sight, and one of the remaining stormtroopers expressed shock that anyone could disappear so effectively before Maul impaled them in the abdomen. The remaining stormtrooper lost sight of their peers and asked for a response, receiving none. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] stabbed the trooper from behind.<ref name="Resurrection" />

At the entrance to the fortress, Vader used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to telekinetically open its doors. Inside, he commented on the place's strength with the dark side, while one of his stormtrooper companions commented that the Rebels could not have picked a more foreboding place to hide. This prompted the other stormtrooper to explain the history of Kalakar Six, claiming that a [[Standard century/Legends|century]] earlier, an aristocrat named [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Yorn (noble)|Yorn]] had travelled there with his followers and built a fortress to conduct experiments with the dark side. A [[Supply ship/Legends|supply ship]] later arrived, and it was discovered that Yorn had gone insane, tearing out his [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and [[Tongue/Legends|tongue]], and his followers had disappeared. The troopers discussed their feelings of unease and nausea before the one who told Yorn's tale started choking. The other stormtrooper pleaded with Vader, believing that he was telekinetically choking their peer, but also began choking as well while Vader stated that he was not responsible.<ref name="Resurrection" />

===Dark side debates===
{{Quote|It was a tragedy when Maul died at the hands of a Jedi. Now he lives again. He will replace you at the Master's right hand.|One of the dark side adherents, to Vader|<ref name="Resurrection" />}}
[[File:DVvDM_Resurrection.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Maul reveals himself to Vader.]]
Vader activated his [[Darth Vader's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and demanded that his opponents reveal themselves. One of the adherents chastised the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] for brandishing his weapon and addressed him by name. They explained that they had lured Vader to Kalakar Six and would not harm him. Vader questioned who they were, and the adherents responded that they were fellow adherents to the dark side. Vader then deduced that the intelligence about the Rebel presence had been a ruse to lure him, which the adherents confirmed. Vader questioned why they had killed all of his stormtroopers, and the adherents claimed that they were unnecessary and that all of those outside were dead too. They stated that they were only interested in Vader, as they found him wanting. Vader responded indignantly and challenged the adherents' right to question a Dark Lord of the Sith. The adherents responded that they had gathered secret Sith knowledge, known only otherwise to Vader and Palpatine, and declared that Vader was unworthy to be a Sith because of his past as Anakin Skywalker. Vader claimed that nothing of his Jedi self remained, while the adherents claimed that a spark of light remained. At this point, Maul observed the conversation silently from the shadows.<ref name="Resurrection" />

One of the adherents declared that Vader was not truly of the lineage of [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] and unfit to serve the Emperor. Offended, Vader went to strike down the adherents, only to have his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] blocked by Maul, whom he immediately recognised. The two began crossing blades until the adherents ordered Maul to stop. Vader questioned how Maul had been resurrected, to which the adherents claimed that there were ways to create and mold an individual if their hatred was strong enough. They believed that Maul would be a more fitting apprentice for the Emperor and that Vader had been tainted. Vader asked if the Emperor was aware of what was happening, which the adherents denied, although they believed Palpatine would approve once he learned of their deeds. One of the adherents claimed that Vader posed too great of a risk to the dark side, which should not rely upon the individual who had been trained by Kenobi, Maul's original killer.<ref name="Resurrection" />

===Duel of the apprentices===
{{Quote|Maul is dead! You are a sham!''"<br />"''No&hellip; you are the sham. Jedi.|Vader and Maul|<ref name="Resurrection" />}}
[[File:Maul_v_Vader.jpg|thumb|right|350px|Vader lunges towards Maul.]]
Vader challenged the adherents on whether they believed either he or Palpatine would tolerate their actions. The adherents responded that Maul would defeat Vader to Palpatine's approval. One of them suggested that Vader could strike the adherents down and refuse the duel, but claimed that would weaken him in Palpatine's eyes and would leave Vader wondering if Maul was truly stronger than him. Vader declared that he would kill Maul and charged towards him. As their lightsabers clashed, Vader claimed that Maul was dead and that the one before him was a sham, an insult Maul redirected towards Vader while also calling him a Jedi as he kicked him in the head. Maul stepped backward as he taunted Vader about a small piece of the light that Vader refused to extinguish, while claiming that his own darkness and hatred were unending as they locked sabers again. Vader responded that he would show the power of the dark side and used the Force to fire one of the dead stormtroopers' blasters at Maul. The Zabrak deflected the bolts and stated Vader's "toy soldiers" could not help him before Force pushing the stormtroopers into the [[Magma/Legends|lava]] pit below them.<ref name="Resurrection" />

Vader responded that he did not require help to destroy an "imposter" and began striking at Maul again. Maul taunted him by stating that Vader wore a mask and hid his unworthiness to be a Sith, suggesting rhetorically that Vader was truly the imposter. At that point, the duel had moved on to a bridge over the lava pit, and one of the suspension ropes was cut. Maul leapt over Vader and expressed surprise at how well Vader had stood his ground before slashing the remaining ropes to send Vader into the lava pit. The cyborg grabbed a rope and dropped onto solid ground beneath him. Maul acknowledged that Vader had landed with grace while still calling him a Jedi. Vader leapt over to where Maul had landed, so Maul jumped to block his lightsaber midair, leaving both on the opposite sides of a lava river.<ref name="Resurrection" />

===Taunts===
{{Quote|They are more evenly matched than we suspected.''"<br />"''But Maul will be victorious.''"<br />"''He is an engine of pure hate. This other&hellip; there's too much of the light in him.|The dark side adherents, observing the duel|<ref name="Resurrection" />}}
[[File:Vader_head_wound.png|thumb|left|230px|Maul strikes Vader in the head.]]
Maul began reciting a lesson from Palpatine about how one should never break a fall, as being prepared to do so meant one was preparing for a fall, which was not an option for the Sith. He also concluded that "There is no pain where strength lies," to which Vader responded that Maul had been taught well by his master, although Vader claimed to have learned his lessons more effectively. Simultaneously, Vader telekinetically threw a segment of the fallen bridge at Maul, causing him to leap upwards. Maul goaded Vader to follow him, which he did so as the duel continued on a chunk of rock atop the lava. One of the adherents expressed surprise, as Vader and Maul had been more evenly matched than they anticipated. The other adherents claimed that Maul would be victorious as he was driven by pure hatred, while there was too much of the light in Vader. Maul's saber then cut across Vader's armor across his abdomen before Maul leapt onto a different rock. As Vader winced in pain, Maul taunted him to follow and finish their combat.<ref name="Resurrection" />

Vader agreed that they would finish the duel and leapt over. As they continued clashing their blades, Maul questioned how Vader could be a fitting servant for Palpatine, as he appeared to be more machine than man. After leaping under one of Vader's strikes, Maul asked how could a machine hate or defeat him. After kicking near Vader's head, he also reminded Vader that he had killed Jinn, Kenobi's master, to which Vader countered that Kenobi had killed Maul once before. At that moment, Vader sliced through Maul's lightsaber, but the Zabrak Sith activated [[Jar'Kai/Legends|both ends]] of his weapon and began striking, damaging Vader's [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]].<ref name="Resurrection" />

===Vader victorious===
{{Quote|This&hellip; This is not possible."''<br />''"We were so certain.|The adherents, after Vader defeated Maul|<ref name="Resurrection" />}}
[[File:Vadermauls.jpg|thumb|right|230px|Darth Vader defeats Darth Maul.]]
Vader dropped his lightsaber and fell to his knees as Maul declared that Palpatine would now have a worthy Sith apprentice. Maul turned behind to look at a lava fall, which the ground they were standing on was floating towards, and asserted that there would be no Jedi pyre for Vader, addressing him as "Skywalker." Maul held up part of his lightsaber to kill Vader and proclaimed that Vader's hatred was not enough to defeat him. As he did so, Vader Force pulled his deactivated lightsaber into his hands, aiming the blade into his own body. He activated it, with the blade passing through his abdomen and hitting Maul.<ref name="Resurrection" />

In his final moments, Maul questioned what Vader could hate enough to defeat him, to which Vader replied "myself." Maul fell to the ground and Vader leapt off before the landmass fell down the lava fall. The shocked adherents were near the fall's edge and wondered how they could have miscalculated. Vader told them that they had brought doom upon themselves, but as he swung his lightsaber, the three were [[Force lightning/Legends|electrocuted]] to death by Palpatine, who had arrived with several [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Royal Guards]]. Palpatine commented on Vader's survival and expressed approval.<ref name="Resurrection" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Master? Was any of this known to you? What these acolytes were attempting?''"<br />"''Why&hellip; no apprentice. Of course not.|Vader and Palpatine, immediately after the duel.|<ref name="Resurrection" />}}
[[File:Kalakar_Six_aftermath.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Vader bows before his master after winning the duel.]]
Vader bowed and queried how Palpatine had arrived on Kalakar Six, and his master stated that his shuttle had followed Vader's. The Emperor had hoped that Vader would be retrieving the stolen Death Star plans and deduced that they were not present. Vader explained that the adherents had lured him to the moon and that they had recreated Maul. Palpatine replied that it was possible for some to resurrect others and claimed that the three adherents were heretics who believed they could provide him with a superior apprentice. Vader asked if Palpatine was aware of what the adherents were trying to do, which Palpatine denied before insisting that Vader join him to continue their efforts to recover the plans. The apprentice paused for a moment before following his master.<ref name="Resurrection" />

Word of the duel between Maul and Vader managed to travel off Kalakar Six as a rumor.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|194|Kalakar Six}}</ref> Meanwhile, Vader [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|tracked]] the Death Star plans to the [[Consular ship/Legends|consular ship]] [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']] above Tatooine<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> thanks to information his [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] was able to recover from the [[raid on Polis Massa]].<ref name="BF2">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref> However, the plans were taken away from the ship, ultimately leading to the Death Star's destruction at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> as the adherents had predicted,<ref name="Resurrection" /> Vader returned to the light to save his son, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], by [[Battle of Endor/Legends|killing]] the Emperor, although Vader also died as a result.<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
==="Resurrection"===
{{Quote|Ladies and Gentlemen! Boys and Girls! Droids and Jawas! Prepare yourselves for the battle of the century! In this corner, weighing in at 220 pounds, the terror from Tatooine, the Dark Lord of the Sith, the former Anakin Skywalker &mdash; DARTH VADER! And in this corner, weighing in at 175 pounds, a killer of Jedi, the Naboo Annihilator, Darth Sidious' #1 apprentice &mdash; DARTH MAUL!|A blurb for ''Star Wars Tales'' 9 promoting the duel|<ref name="Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/00-458/Star-Wars-Tales-9-photo-cover|text=Star Wars Tales 9}}</ref>}}
[[File:StarWarsTales9-AltCover.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The alternate cover for ''Star Wars Tales'' 9 that promoted the duel as a combat sports matchup.]]
The duel on Kalakar Six was created for the [[Star Wars comic books|comic story]] "[[Resurrection (comic story)|Resurrection]]," written by [[Ron Marz]] and illustrated by [[Rick Leonardi]] for publication in the [[Star Wars Tales 9|ninth issue]] of the series ''[[Star Wars Tales]]''.<ref name="Resurrection" /> The duel was first mentioned in a preview of comics planned for release in [[September]] of [[2001]] that was published on [[StarWars.com]] on [[June 7]] of that year, which included the issue's cover art depicting the duel.<ref name="September 2001 Comics">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/comics/news20010607.html|text=September 2001 Comics}}</ref> The comic was later published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[October 10]], 2001.<ref name="Dark Horse" /> The issue features a satirical introduction comic in which assistant editor [[Philip Simon]] gives a tour of the office where Marz, Leonardi, and inker [[Terry Austin]]&mdash;depicted as [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]]&mdash;work on the duel. Simon discusses the apparently high pain thresholds of both combatants given their past experiences.<ref name="Resurrection" />

An alternate photographic cover design was also released, which presented the duel as a combat sport-style promotional poster, accompanied by a blurb that took the tone of a sports announcer.<ref name="Dark Horse" />  [[Lee Dawson]], writing for the "[[Comics Link]]" department of the  [[Star Wars Insider 55|fifty-fifth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine,<ref name="Insider 55">{{InsiderCite|55|Comics Link}}</ref> first shipped to subscribers on [[July 20]], 2001<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20010705.html|text=Mace Windu talks Episode II}}</ref> felt that the duel was the ultimate ''[[Star Wars]]'' showdown and encapsulated the exciting possibilities offered by the ''Tales'' series.<ref name="Insider 55" /> The duel was chosen as one of the top twenty most memorable moments of the ''Star Wars'' [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] in an article written by [[Abel G. Peña]] and [[Enrique Guerrero]] published in the [[Star Wars Insider 83|eighty-third issue]] of ''Insider'',<ref name="Insider 83">{{InsiderCite|83|20 Most Memorable Moments of the Expanded Universe}}</ref> first published to subscribers on July 20, [[2005]].<ref name="Insider 83 Date">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20050712.html|text=Top 20 EU Moments in ''Star Wars Insider'' #83}}</ref> 

===Continuity===
{{Quote|It's not quite the real Darth Maul. Hence the "or something." Who knows, it could have been a vision like Luke confronting Vader on Dagobah or just some sort of Sith illusion. Or a clone. Nothing's been determined as to what we are actually seeing, just that Vader and Maul have a pretty cool battle.|Leland Chee in a blog post that suggested the events of "Resurrection" were canon to the Expanded Universe|<ref name="Chee" />}}
[[File:DarthMaul-Visionaries.png|thumb|left|200px|Darth Maul as he appeared in "Old Wounds," another comic that featured his return after ''The Phantom Menace''.]]
The events of "Resurrection" were referred to as [[Canon|non-canon]] within issues of ''Star Wars Insider'' in the initial years following its publication, beginning with the "Comics Link" department in ''Insider'' 55, which identified it as "non-continuity."<ref name="Insider 55" /> Subsequent editions of magazine also referred to the duel as "imaginary"<ref name="Insider 58">{{InsiderCite|58|Comics Link}}</ref> and as a "possible history [[Infinities]]" story.<ref name="Insider 69">{{InsiderCite|69|Comics Link}}</ref> The [[2004]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Panel to Panel]]'', edited by [[Randy Stradley]], also referred to the comic as Infinities.<ref name="Panel">''[[Star Wars: Panel to Panel]]''</ref>

In the "[[Star Wars Q&A|Ask the Master]]" department of the [[Star Wars Insider 85|eighty-fifth]] issue of ''Insider'',<ref name="Insider 85">{{InsiderCite|85|Star Wars Q&A|Ask the Master}}</ref> first shipped to subscribers on [[November 14]], 2005,<ref name="Insider 85 date">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20051101.html|text=More Vader in ''Star Wars Insider'' #85}}</ref> a fan asked whether the duel took place after Maul's death in the comic "[[Old Wounds]]"&mdash;published in the graphic novel anthology ''[[Star Wars: Visionaries]]'' on [[April 2]], 2005<ref name="Inside Star Wars: Visionaries">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/comics/news20050315.html|text=Inside ''Star Wars: Visionaries''}}</ref>&mdash;where he was [[Duel at the Lars homestead|shot]] by<ref name="Insider 85" /> the [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]]<ref name="ANH" /> [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]]<ref name="Insider 85" /> in [[16 BBY/Legends|16 BBY]].<ref name="16 BBY">"[[Old Wounds]]" states that it takes place three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] occupation, which began in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Therefore, the comic must take place in [[16 BBY/Legends|16 BBY]].</ref> Author [[Pablo Hidalgo]] responded that the events of both "Resurrection" and "Old Wounds" were considered non-canon.<ref name="Insider 85" /> 

However, [[Holocron continuity database]] keeper [[Leland Chee]] suggested that the events of "Resurrection" were canon in a StarWars.com [[Star Wars: Blogs|blog]] on [[January 19]], [[2006]]. He stated that it was still ambiguous whether the "real" Maul had fought Vader, and that his resurrection could have been brought about through [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]], cloning, or that it may have been a vision like the one had by Luke Skywalker in<ref name="Chee" /> the [[Cave of Evil/Legends|Cave of Evil]] in the [[1980]] original trilogy film [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']].<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref> Chee later stated on [[June 4]], 2006 that stories published in ''Star Wars Tales'' were considered S-canon if they were not intentionally comedic or outrageous, and were elevated to C-canon if referenced in another source.<ref name="SWB">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=752#14952461|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2006-06-04|time=3:05 AM}}</ref>

The duel was later mentioned in Kalakar Six's entry in the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', which stated that the moon was "reputedly" the site of a duel between Maul and Vader.<ref name="CSWE" /> Although the characters in "Resurrection" refer to Maul's death at Kenobi's hands<ref name="Resurrection" /> as apparently shown in the [[1999]] film ''The Phantom Menace'',<ref name="TPM" /> Maul was revealed to have survived his injuries in the animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', beginning with the episode "[[Witches of the Mist]]," which aired on [[January 21]], [[2011]].<ref name="Witches of the Mist Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode314.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Witches of the Mist}}</ref>

[[File:Maul-Vader-Duel-MSL.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Another duel between Vader and Maul was fought in the canon animated series ''Maul - Shadow Lord''.]]
In current ''Star Wars'' canon, [[Maul]] and [[Anakin Skywalker|Vader]] [[Operations on Janix|fought]] each other on the [[planet]] [[Janix]] in "[[Chapter 10: The Dark Lord]]," the finale of the [[Maul - Shadow Lord Season 1|first season]] of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Maul - Shadow Lord]]'',<ref name="Chapter 10">{{MSL|Chapter 10: The Dark Lord}}</ref> which premiered on [[May 4]], [[2026]].<ref name="Chapter 10 Twitter">{{Twitter|starwars|status/2033951658485682588|''[[Star Wars]]''|date=2026-03-17|archivefile=File:MaulShadowLord-EpisodeTitles-Twitter.jpg}}</ref> On the same date, Vader and Maul's Legends duel was highlighted in a trivia article about ''Maul - Shadow Lord'' written by [[Kristin Baver]] and published on StarWars.com. The article described "Resurrection" as "non-canon," although it was not specified whether this referred to the status of "Resurrection" within Legends continuity or to Legends media as a whole.<ref name="Trivia">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-maul-shadow-lord-trivia|text=Inside the Making of ''Star Wars: Maul – Shadow Lord'' - Update}}</ref> This article treats the duel as canon within the ''Star Wars'' Legends continuity.
